serverInfo.name: keypay-mcp
serverInfo.title: Employment Hero Payroll (KeyPay) MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Employment Hero Payroll (KeyPay), hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show my latest pay run and its total gross and net wages."; "Which leave requests are still pending approval?"; "What is Jane Smith's annual leave balance?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Employment Hero Payroll (KeyPay) data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run keypay_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run keypay_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run keypay_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. keypay_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: keypay_get_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The Employment Hero Payroll user this API key belongs to: id, email, display name and time zone. GET /user.

tools.name: keypay_list_businesses
tools.title: List businesses
tools.description: List the payroll businesses this user can access: id, name, region, legal name, contact details, pay cycle, number of employees. Start here: most other tools need a business id. GET /business (OData).

top.description: Results per request, 1-100 (default 25; the API caps it at 100).

skip.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

filter.description: OData v3 $filter. Property names are capitalised, e.g. "Surname eq 'Smith'", "StartTime gt datetime'2026-04-01T00:00:00'", "DefaultSuperRate ne 9.5M".

tools.name: keypay_get_business
tools.title: Get business
tools.description: One business by id: name, legal name, contact, address, ABN/company details, leave year, standard hours, pay cycle. GET /business/{businessId}.

tools.name: keypay_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the business's employees with basic details: id, name, preferred name, gender, date of birth, contact details, address, start and end date, external id. Tax file, bank and super details are not part of this list. Filter with OData, e.g. "Surname eq 'Smith'". GET /business/{businessId}/employee/details (OData).

top.description: Results per request, 1-100 (default 25; the API caps it at 100).

skip.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

filter.description: OData v3 $filter. Property names are capitalised, e.g. "Surname eq 'Smith'", "StartTime gt datetime'2026-04-01T00:00:00'", "DefaultSuperRate ne 9.5M".

tools.name: keypay_get_employee
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: One employee's full record: name, contact, employment type, status, start/end date, pay schedule, primary location and pay category, rate and rate unit, hours per week, award, leave template, work types, tags. Tax file / national insurance / IRD / NRIC numbers, bank accounts and super member numbers are removed. GET /business/{businessId}/employee/unstructured/{employeeId}.

tools.name: keypay_get_leave_balances
tools.title: Get employee leave balances
tools.description: An employee's leave balances per leave category (accrued amount and unit), optionally as at a date. GET /business/{businessId}/employee/{employeeId}/leavebalances.

as_at_date.description: Balance as at this date (yyyy-mm-dd); default today.

tools.name: keypay_list_pay_runs
tools.title: List pay runs
tools.description: List the business's pay runs: id, pay schedule, pay period start/end, date paid, finalised flag, payslips published, notation. Newest first with orderby "PayPeriodEnding desc". GET /business/{businessId}/payrun (OData).

top.description: Results per request, 1-100 (default 25; the API caps it at 100).

skip.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

filter.description: OData v3 $filter. Property names are capitalised, e.g. "Surname eq 'Smith'", "StartTime gt datetime'2026-04-01T00:00:00'", "DefaultSuperRate ne 9.5M".

tools.name: keypay_get_pay_run
tools.title: Get pay run
tools.description: One pay run by id: pay schedule, period, date paid, whether it is finalised, notation. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}.

tools.name: keypay_list_pay_run_summaries
tools.title: List pay run summaries
tools.description: Pay runs with their totals: total hours, gross wages and net wages, plus the usual pay run fields. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/summary (OData).

top.description: Results per request, 1-100 (default 25; the API caps it at 100).

skip.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

filter.description: OData v3 $filter. Property names are capitalised, e.g. "Surname eq 'Smith'", "StartTime gt datetime'2026-04-01T00:00:00'", "DefaultSuperRate ne 9.5M".

tools.name: keypay_get_pay_run_summary
tools.title: Get pay run summary
tools.description: One pay run with its total hours, gross wages and net wages. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}/summary.

tools.name: keypay_get_pay_run_totals
tools.title: Get pay run totals per employee
tools.description: Per-employee totals of a pay run (gross, net, tax withheld, super and the like; the fields depend on the region). Bank payment details are removed. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}/totals.

tools.name: keypay_get_pay_run_payslips
tools.title: Get pay slip data of a pay run
tools.description: Pay slip data for every employee in a pay run, keyed by employee: earnings lines, deductions, tax, super, leave taken and accrued, gross/net and year-to-date totals. Large for big pay runs. Bank account numbers and tax/identity numbers are removed. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}/payslips.

show_all_data.description: Include all pay slip data, not only what is printed on the slip (default false).

tools.name: keypay_list_pay_run_warnings
tools.title: List pay run warnings
tools.description: Warnings on a pay run (for example an employee paid below their award rate or with a negative net pay): type, employee and message. GET /business/{businessId}/payrun/{payRunId}/warnings.

tools.name: keypay_list_timesheets
tools.title: List timesheets
tools.description: List the business's timesheet lines: employee, start/end time, units, work type, location, status, comments, breaks. Filter by employee or date with OData, e.g. "EmployeeId eq 123 and StartTime gt datetime'2026-04-01T00:00:00'". GET /business/{businessId}/timesheet (OData: $filter, $orderby, $top, $skip).

top.description: Results per request, 1-100 (default 25; the API caps it at 100).

skip.description: Results to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_skip.

filter.description: OData v3 $filter. Property names are capitalised, e.g. "Surname eq 'Smith'", "StartTime gt datetime'2026-04-01T00:00:00'", "DefaultSuperRate ne 9.5M".

tools.name: keypay_get_timesheet
tools.title: Get timesheet line
tools.description: One timesheet line by id. GET /business/{businessId}/timesheet/{timesheetLineId}.

tools.name: keypay_list_leave_requests

tools.description: List the business's leave requests: employee, leave category, from/to date, total hours, status (Approved, Pending, Rejected, Cancelled), notes. Filter by status, dates, category, location or employee. GET /business/{businessId}/leaverequest.

from_date.description: Only leave starting on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

to_date.description: Only leave ending on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.description: One leave request: employee, category, dates, hours, status, notes. GET /business/{businessId}/employee/{employeeId}/leaverequest/{leaveRequestId}.

tools.name: keypay_report_gross_to_net
tools.title: Gross to net report
tools.description: Gross-to-net report per employee: earnings by pay category, tax, deductions, super, net pay. Choose a date range (from_date + to_date) or one finalised pay run (pay_run_id). The report has no paging: at most 200 rows are returned (narrow with employee_id or location_id). GET /business/{businessId}/report/grosstonet.

pay_run_id.description: A pay run id: report that pay run (then from_date/to_date are ignored).

from_date.description: Start of the date range (yyyy-mm-dd), with to_date.

tools.name: keypay_report_leave_balances
tools.title: Leave balances report
tools.description: Leave balances of all employees as at a date, per leave category. The report has no paging: at most 200 rows are returned (narrow with location_id or leave_category_id). For one employee use keypay_get_leave_balances. GET /business/{businessId}/report/leavebalances.

as_at_date.description: Balances as at this date (yyyy-mm-dd); default today.

tools.name: keypay_approve_leave_request
tools.title: Approve leave request
tools.description: WRITE: approves a pending leave request (the employee is notified and the leave is applied to their pay). Check the request first with keypay_get_leave_request. Cannot be undone through this server. POST /business/{businessId}/employee/{employeeId}/leaverequest/{leaveRequestId}/approve.

tools.name: keypay_decline_leave_request
tools.title: Decline leave request
tools.description: WRITE: declines a leave request, with an optional reason the employee sees. Check the request first with keypay_get_leave_request. POST /business/{businessId}/employee/{employeeId}/leaverequest/{leaveRequestId}/decline.
